title: 〜も (emphasising quantity) "as many as / even"
meaning: After a number, も stresses that the amount is large; with negatives, that it is zero ("not even one").
simpleExplanation: After a number, も says the amount is surprisingly large: 十時間も寝た = "I slept a whole ten hours!". With a negative and the number one, it means "not even one": 一円もない = "I don't have a single yen". With a question word plus counter (何回も, 何人も) it means "many". So the same little も that means "also" becomes an emphasis marker when it follows a quantity.
whenUsed: Everyday exaggeration and complaint (三時間も待った), impressed remarks (百人も来た), and total denial (一度も行ったことがない). Works in all registers. The opposite feeling ("only") is しか〜ない (lesson 60).
formation: Number + counter + も + affirmative: 三時間も待った (as long as three hours)
一 + counter + も + negative: 一人も来なかった (not a single person came)
何 + counter + も: 何回も (many times), 何年も (for years)
も replaces を / が; with other particles it follows them: 十か国にも行った

examples.reading: きのうは じゅうじかんも ねた。
examples.en: I slept a whole ten hours yesterday.
examples.note: Ten hours is a lot: も expresses surprise.

examples.reading: さいふには いちえんも ない。
examples.en: I don't have a single yen in my wallet.
examples.note: 一 + counter + も + negative = not even one.

examples.ja: 彼は何回も日本へ行ったことがある。
examples.reading: かれは なんかいも にほんへ いったことが ある。
examples.en: He has been to Japan many times.

examples.ja: このケーキ、一つ千円もするんですか。
examples.reading: このケーキ、ひとつ せんえんも するんですか。
examples.en: This cake costs a whole thousand yen each?
examples.note: も after a price expresses that it is expensive.

examples.ja: 今年は一度も風邪をひいていません。
examples.reading: ことしは いちども かぜを ひいていません。
examples.en: I haven't caught a cold even once this year.

similarGrammar.difference: しか stresses that the amount is small (三人しか来なかった). も stresses that it is large.
だけ limits neutrally (三人だけ来た). も carries surprise at a large number.
ばかり says something is "nothing but" (肉ばかり食べる). も after a number is about quantity, not exclusivity.

commonMistakes.right: 一人も来ませんでした。／ 一人だけ来ました。
commonMistakes.why: 一 + counter + も must be followed by a negative ("not even one"). For "only one came" use だけ or しか〜ない.

commonMistakes.wrong: 昨日は五時間をも勉強した。
commonMistakes.right: 昨日は五時間も勉強した。
commonMistakes.why: も replaces を; you cannot use both.

commonMistakes.wrong: 何回も行ったことがありません。(meaning: never)
commonMistakes.right: 一回も行ったことがありません。
commonMistakes.why: 何回も is "many times" and normally takes an affirmative. For "never" use 一回も / 一度も + negative.

usageNotes: Money and time are the most common: 三万円もした, 二時間も待たされた.
も can also follow 誰 / 何 / どこ + negative for total denial: 誰も来なかった, 何もない.
Tone of voice matters: 十時間も寝た can be proud or embarrassed depending on context.
jlptTips: If the sentence ends in a negative and the number is 一 (一人, 一つ, 一度), も is the answer ("not even one"). If the number is larger and the feeling is "so many", も again.
The classic pair is も vs しか: check the ending. も works with affirmative for large amounts; しか requires a negative verb and means "only".
